request.text: One compact road-mine blast. Hard attack, short low concussive body, torn metal and grit rapidly decaying. Close, no sustained fireball. Timbre: a low compact concussive thud and brief dark fractured-metal tail. Intimate damped metal, low gritty resonance, restrained high end, tiny dry reflection. 2 seconds. Original isolated effect; no music, no voice.
